title: Crack a walnut with a figure nutcracker
instruction: Lift the lever on the nutcracker’s back to open its mouth, put the walnut in the mouth, then press the lever to crack it.
context: A figure-style nutcracker uses a rear lever to open and close its mouth. A related pending board task cracks a walnut with a two-handle nutcracker and sorts the kernel and shell.
setup: Fixed reinforced figure on a 130 × 130 × 12 mm bolted aluminum base; aluminum jaws, carrier and rear lever, PETG exterior (dimensioned REAL_TRIAL.md and fabrication-envelope.csv). Head Ø120 mm, mouth 60 mm wide, upper/moving masses 450/225 g. Figure origin (320,−40,867.5) mm, yaw +90°. One raw dried in-shell English walnut, nominal 36 × 32 × 36 mm and 14 g, from a recorded lot, at (200,130,766.5) mm before settling on a 747.5 mm table. Two ready-pose YAM arms.
scoring: Video witness: opposing jaw contact with ≥1° closure, then continuous mouth custody and no robot/other-object shell contact until first ≥0.5mm fissure and first ≥3mm normal opening. Threshold provenance is irreversible; no reveal deadline. Valid crack plus final2s released containment earns1.0; never-measurably-cracked shell seated/supported earns0.25; else0. Grippers open≥70mm/clear≥80mm, fixture moves<10mm, shells on table/in mouth ≤220mm above table. REAL_TRIAL.md specifies ROI and annotation.
reset_notes: New intact raw English walnut from same lot each trial; select 34–38 × 30–34 × 34–38 mm, 12–16 g, condition 48 h at 20–24 C and 40–60% RH. No soaking/scoring/precracking. Inspect and clean jaws, reset lever to zero and arms ready. Physical build/qualification and specimen record in REAL_TRIAL.md.
fidelity: Dimensioned reinforced figure; physical fabrication/load qualification unperformed. Rigid envelopes, assigned masses and unmeasured friction approximate the hollow/metal build. Walnut is two rigid halves with an uncalibrated 200 N/5 Nm seam and attached visual kernel. Observable opening/contact/custody approximate REAL_TRIAL.md video scoring. Board demo combines synchronized station and witness views of one run; Dream uses its native station view.
scores: Revised scripted demo 1.0 in 1553/2400 actions (243.684 s wall); matching Dream-1 beta 0.0 at 2400 actions (370.181 s wall). Seed 0, no native errors; identical runtime d2bcea4533dbe1db36180c2d39d4963d59f25369131c29783bf2afc7c356210e.
